name: Earbuds
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: Tuned for in-ear and open earbuds. Adds the sub-bass weight small drivers lose to fit and seal (with a little harmonic support), dynamically tames the 6-8 kHz in-ear resonance on sibilants and cymbals, and uses crossfeed to relax hard-panned mixes that feel unnatural so close to the ear.
